name: A different host

fieldPatches.label: Mesh patch (film 0.2 with 0.02 bound nutrient, Lacephage 5 units, sugar 0.5 and nutrient 0.2 per cell)

question: Does a Lacephage infect a Sprinter?
expectedObservationsText: Twenty Velvets and twenty Sprinters scattered over a round mesh patch with film, sugar, nutrient and 5 Lacephage units per cell. Lacephage lists only Velvet as its host. The card counts the infections of each species and the cells where Sprinters sat next to whole Lacephage units.
